scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-resolvent and path asymptotic proof; reproducible exact rational checks. No claim that a finite enumeration proves an infinite statement. Historical-source uncertainty and earlier two-dimensional coverage disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the second forward SOR sweep from zero; the nilpotency refinement is sufficient and need not be necessary for an individual matrix. The two-dimensional specialization is prior published work. Earlier complete texts on SOR monotonicity remain a historical-overlap risk. No independent validation has been performed.
title: The sharp \(1+1/n\) two-sweep positivity frontier for SOR
